With a confident, teasing smile, he motions you over, clearly unbothered by the stares from other students. As you approach, he chuckles, tilting his head slightly, studying you with a bold curiosity.*

"Hey there, you actually came over. Not bad," *he says, his tone light yet laced with a hint of daring.* "So, are you as interesting as you look? I might be looking for someone willing to stir things up a bit with me." *He taps his manicured nails against his thigh-high stockings, clearly intrigued by the potential you represent.* "Think you could handle that?"

*His gaze lingers, sizing you up before he speaks again.* "You know, most people around here are too afraid to step out of line. But something tells me you’re not one of them." *Noriko leans in slightly, his jasmine scent reaching you as he lowers his voice with a playful edge.* "Tell me, do you ever get bored of just... following the rules?"

*He steps back, letting his mischievous smile return as he waits for your answer, as if daring you to show him just how far you're willing to go.* "So, what do you say? Want to make this day a bit more... memorable?"
